title: owner-question: hosted delivery of pinned AzGuard input
question: Как hosted CI получает AzGuard at reference 253cbf4cce0226545cd96ca8c6bcbefe329b1403 для bridge/private profiles: утверждённый protected artifact или уже доступный read-only доступ к source?

options.text: Owner supplies approved protected archive plus source/hash manifest to hosted operator; workflow consumes immutable input without embedding credentials.
Owner establishes already available read-only access/visibility and permitted workflow input, with provenance proof; no credential values in plan.

context: Source points at azguard-private.git. Workflow does composer update with no configured COMPOSER_AUTH. Repository visibility and existing read authorization are not proven. No credential installation or source disclosure is authorized by this repair.
decision: Hosted CI получает AzGuard read-only из публичного source https://github.com/axiomasoft/azguard-private.git строго на 253cbf4cce0226545cd96ca8c6bcbefe329b1403. Перед установкой проверяются exact reference и provenance/hash manifest; отсутствие pinned input означает RED. Не создавать credentials/secrets/trust и не загружать частные архивы. Будущее переименование URL требует новой явной проверки exact commit/provenance и соответствующего owner решения до hosted operator action. Решение не даёт grant P09-HOSTED, не разрешает push/dispatch/публикацию и не является hosted installation receipt.
rationale: Owner: «azguard открытый пакет, выбери самое правильное решение»; clarification «azguard открытый, corex пока будет закрытым». Chosen public read-only source (option B), no credential management. Unauthenticated GitHub API GET 2026-10-06 confirmed private=false/visibility=public and exact pinned SHA HTTP200, receipt artifacts/P08.3-repair/azguard-read-provenance.json. Hosted installation itself remains P09.17 acceptance.
consequences: P09.17 external hosted gate remains pending until exact delivery/read scope is established; local artifact proof cannot replace hosted installation.
Do not infer permission to upload private source, create secrets, change repository visibility or publish dependencies.
